official_sources.title: GDAL rasterize default center rule
official_sources.finding: Default polygon rasterization updates pixels whose center is within the polygon; ALL_TOUCHED changes membership.

official_sources.title: GDAL rasterize all-touched rule
official_sources.finding: -at updates all pixels touched by polygons or lines, so it is a different domain policy from center-based selection.

official_sources.title: GDAL rasterize edge order
official_sources.finding: With ALL_TOUCHED, feature order can affect edge pixels; deterministic feature ordering is required.

official_sources.title: GDAL rasterize center-touch ambiguity
official_sources.finding: Behavior is unspecified when a polygon merely touches the pixel center under normal rendering, so boundary cases need independent topology replay.

official_sources.title: GDAL vector rasterize default semantics
official_sources.finding: Default and --all-touched modes are explicitly different and must not be mixed between passes.

official_sources.title: GDAL vector rasterize all-touched ordering
official_sources.finding: When all-touched is enabled, input feature order can affect results.

official_sources.title: Rasterio geometry_mask center semantics
official_sources.finding: all_touched=False includes pixels by center-within semantics for polygons.

official_sources.title: Rasterio geometry_mask all-touched
official_sources.finding: all_touched=True includes every touched pixel, a broader membership set.

official_sources.title: Rasterio mask crop behavior
official_sources.finding: crop changes output window/transform and must not be confused with full-grid membership.

official_sources.title: Rasterio mask padding
official_sources.finding: pad expands crop by half-pixel units and is disallowed for terminal exact-domain membership unless explicitly pinned.

official_sources.title: Rasterio features rasterize semantics
official_sources.finding: rasterize distinguishes center/Bresenham from all-touched and supports explicit transform.

official_sources.title: Rasterio features invalid-shape behavior
official_sources.finding: Invalid or empty shapes may be skipped with warnings; terminal membership must fail closed instead of silently skipping.

official_sources.title: Rasterio features merge algorithm
official_sources.finding: Replace and add merge algorithms produce different outputs; membership masks require a fixed replace-style policy.

official_sources.title: Rasterio geometry_window rounding
official_sources.finding: geometry_window floors offsets and ceilings width/height to cover geometry, so it is a candidate window not a membership proof.

official_sources.title: Rasterio feature painter order
official_sources.finding: Later geometries overwrite earlier ones under painter order; deterministic ordering is required when values differ.

official_sources.title: Rasterio rio mask option
official_sources.finding: CLI mask exposes the same center-versus-all-touched policy distinction.

official_sources.title: Rasterio pixel xy center
official_sources.finding: xy returns pixel center by default and corners only with explicit offset.

official_sources.title: Rasterio geo-to-rowcol
official_sources.finding: rowcol maps georeferenced coordinates to raster row/column for independent address replay.

official_sources.title: Rasterio affine ignores Z
official_sources.finding: Affine xy/rowcol calculations ignore Z; horizontal membership remains separate from elevation.

official_sources.title: GDAL inverse geotransform
official_sources.finding: GetInverse converts geo coordinates back to pixel coordinates and can fail if transform is uninvertible.

official_sources.title: GDAL raster clip geometry selection
official_sources.finding: Geometry clip selects overlapping pixels and writes outside-geometry pixels as nodata or zero within the crop box.

official_sources.title: GDAL raster clip only-bbox
official_sources.finding: --only-bbox discards polygon shape and cannot serve as exact parcel membership.

official_sources.title: GDAL raster clip pixel-boundary rounding
official_sources.finding: Clip bounds are rounded to whole input pixels without resampling; output window identity must still be reconciled.

official_sources.title: GDAL raster clip geometry CRS
official_sources.finding: Geometry CRS may be transformed to input raster CRS without raster reprojection, so geometry transform must be logged.

official_sources.title: GDAL raster clip outside source
official_sources.finding: Outside-source pixels can become zero or nodata; they cannot be mistaken for valid cells.

official_sources.title: GDAL raster compare spatial identity
official_sources.finding: Golden comparison checks pixel content, datatype, nodata, CRS and geotransform unless skipped.

official_sources.title: GDAL raster compare skip risk
official_sources.finding: Skipping CRS/geotransform/metadata weakens mask equivalence and is rejected for terminal replay.

official_sources.title: GDAL raster create nodata
official_sources.finding: Mask raster creation must pin size, datatype, CRS, bbox and nodata rather than defaults.

official_sources.title: GDAL create template pixels not copied
official_sources.finding: --like copies layout defaults but not pixel values, so template identity alone does not prove mask content.

official_sources.title: GDAL nodata-to-alpha
official_sources.finding: Nodata can be represented as alpha; validity comparison must reconcile both representations.

official_sources.title: GDAL raster band nodata mutation
official_sources.finding: Changing nodata metadata does not rewrite existing pixel values.

official_sources.title: GDAL raster mosaic uncovered zero
official_sources.finding: Uncovered mosaic pixels may be valid zero unless nodata/alpha is explicit.

official_sources.title: GDAL raster calc center coordinates
official_sources.finding: _CENTER_X_ and _CENTER_Y_ expose pixel centers for independent mask calculations.

official_sources.title: GDAL raster calc CRS/extent checks
official_sources.finding: Disabling CRS or extent checks can make spatially mismatched rasters appear compatible.

official_sources.title: GDAL AREA_OR_POINT
official_sources.finding: AREA_OR_POINT describes sample semantics but georeferencing remains area-oriented.

official_sources.title: GDAL NODATA_VALUES caveat
official_sources.finding: Dataset-level NODATA_VALUES is not universally honored.

official_sources.title: GDAL raster info layout ledger
official_sources.finding: Raster info reports size, CRS, geotransform, datatype, block size and nodata.

official_sources.title: GDAL GTI grid identity
official_sources.finding: GTI metadata can define SRS, geotransform, size and nodata of a virtual mosaic.

official_sources.title: GDAL fill-nodata mask meaning
official_sources.finding: Fill-nodata uses zero mask as invalid and interpolates new values, so it is excluded from terminal evidence.

official_sources.title: GDAL vector clip type effects
official_sources.finding: Vector clipping can split collections and drop incompatible parts; derived boundary needs structural-diff review.

official_sources.title: GDAL Python clip source semantics
official_sources.finding: Clipping APIs can select clip geometries before or after reprojection; stage must be explicit.

official_sources.title: Rasterio mask non-overlap behavior
official_sources.finding: Non-overlap yields warning/full mask or ValueError with crop, so no-overlap must fail closed.
